blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. Sale and lease listings.

Commercial property for sale in North Vancouver: industrial buildings and strata units, offices, retail space, commercial land and businesses listed on the MLS®. The search shows space for sale and for lease. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 for a property that is not listed, or to value one you own.
Commercial and industrial areas in North Vancouver

items.t: The City of North Vancouver has 136 hectares of industrial land and the District 292 hectares (July 1, 2025). ([Metro Vancouver 2025 Industrial Lands Inventory](https://metrovancouver.org/services/regional-planning/Documents/mv-industrial-lands-inventory-summary-report-appendices-2025.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

The City lists five industrial centres: the Waterfront; East of Heywood and north of CN Rail; Mackay to Bewicke between 3rd Street and BC Rail; Lower Lonsdale; and Harbourside Business Park. ([City of North Vancouver, industrial land use](https://www.cnv.org/Community-Environment/land-use/industrial), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: What sold across the Lower Mainland

Commercial Edge does not break out North Vancouver in the figures published on this site. Across the Lower Mainland, 285 commercial properties sold in the second quarter of 2026, worth $1,540.8M: 81 industrial, 56 land, 46 office, 82 retail and other, and 20 multi-family.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
